messages.subject: About gtable pacakge
parts:
Dear all,

Since ggplot2 depends on gtable package, not sure if this is the right place to ask questions or not, please let me know if it's inappropriate. 

My question is basically: by the time ggplot2 0.9.2 is released next monday, is the gtable_align related components going to be supported and exported or not? This features is very attractive to me, if that's going to work in next 1 or 2 weeks(bioconductor project has next release in September too...), I can drop my hack in my own package and utilize more elegant and general method here. In my case, I need to align solely based on 'panel' to form tracks, imagine it's two time series data, with slightly different x-limits, and even more complicated case, sometimes only one plot may have legend or don't have y-axis label or have faceted label? to align them, I need to set plots on the same x-limits first which is fairly easy, then next align them solely on major 'panel' regardless of axis or legend box. I guess in this case, if I name those panel with the same colnames, that gtable_align or gtable_join suppose to work for me?

Thanks again~

Tengfei
